policies.sentence: Students are encouraged or welcome to use AI tools in this course.
The instructor welcomes, embraces or does not ban AI tools.
The course assumes students will use AI tools for coding and programming projects.
Students may use AI on coursework, assignments, homework and projects.
Students may use AI as they see fit without needing permission.
Students may use AI to help with coding, programming and debugging.
Students may use AI freely outside graded work and for code they do not submit.
Students may use AI as a learning and study aid to support understanding.
Using AI is optional and not required.
Students must use AI responsibly, transparently and within stated conditions or limits.
Appropriate use of technology as an aid for learning counts as academic honesty.
Students may use non-generative tools and other chat tools such as ChatGPT or Gemini.
Students may use AI for listed purposes, such as supporting their process and understanding.
